mapper.select:
SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsVocListMapper : 고객의소리*/ count(*) FROM ( SELECT AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM , AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT , AA.FRST_REG_DT , AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD , AA.ATFINO , BB.RETE_ESNTAL_NO , '1' AS NUM FROM AYE100 AS AA , AYE120 AS BB WHERE 1=1 AND AA.DEL_YN = 'N' /*삭제여부*/ AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '09' /*게시글유형구분코드*/ AND (AA.DEL_YN = 'N' OR AA.DEL_YN = 'T') AND BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD(+) = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO(+) = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO
AND AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_TTL_NM}||'%'
AND AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO}||'%'
AND AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT LIKE '%'||#{WRTR_NM_ENCPT}||'%'
UNION SELECT BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , BB.RETE_TTL_NM , BB.WRTR_NM_ENCPT , BB.FRST_REG_DT , BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD , BB.ATFINO , BB.RETE_ESNTAL_NO , '2' AS NUM FROM AYE120 AS BB ,AYE100 AS AA WHERE 1=1 AND BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '09' AND BB.DEL_YN = 'N' AND BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD IS NOT NULL
AND BB.RETE_TTL_NM LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_TTL_NM}||'%'
AND BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO}||'%'
AND BB.WRTR_NM_ENCPT LIKE '%'||#{WRTR_NM_ENCPT}||'%'
)AS EE

SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsVocListMapper.selectBbsVocList : 고객의소리(조회)*/ EE.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , CASE WHEN EE.NUM = '2' THEN 'RE: ' || EE.BBSCTT_TTL_NM ELSE EE.BBSCTT_TTL_NM END AS BBSCTT_TTL_NM
, CASE WHEN LENGTH(EE.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) > 23 THEN C##RG.DEC_B64(EE.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) ELSE EE.WRTR_NM_ENCPT END AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT
, EE.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /*게시글구분코드*/ , TO_CHAR(EE.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FRST_REG_DT
, EE.NUM AS NUM , (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE110 Z WHERE Z.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = EE.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND Z.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = EE.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND Z.DEL_YN = 'N') AS CMNT
, COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT FROM ( SELECT AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM , AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT , AA.FRST_REG_DT , AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD
, '1' AS NUM FROM AYE100 AS AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '09' /*게시글유형구분코드*/ AND AA.DEL_YN = 'N'
AND AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_TTL_NM}||'%'
AND AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO}||'%'
AND CASE WHEN LENGTH(AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) > 23 THEN C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) ELSE AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT END LIKE '%'||#{WRTR_NM_ENCPT}||'%'
)AS EE ORDER BY EE.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO DESC , EE.NUM OFFSET #{START_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY

/* * SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsVocListMapper.selectBbsVocDetail : 고객의소리(상세) * 2023.05.31 수정 - Jeong.Won.Je */ SELECT BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 게시글번호 */ , BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AS BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /* 게시글유형구분코드 */ , BBSCTT_TTL_NM AS BBSCTT_TTL_NM /* 게시글제목명 */ , TO_CHAR(FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD AM HH12:MI:SS') AS FRST_REG_DT /* 최초등록일시 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(WRTR_NM_ENCPT) AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT /* 작성자 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(EML_ADDR_ENCPT) AS EML_ADDR_ENCPT /* 이메일주소암호화 */ , WEPS_LINKA_PRCUSE_DMND_YN AS WEPS_LINKA_PRCUSE_DMND_YN /* 웹심리검사이용여부 */ , VOC_INQIRE_TYPE_SE_CD AS VOC_INQIRE_TYPE_SE_CD /* 고객의소리문의유형구분코드 */ , CHRCTR_YN AS CHRCTR_YN /* 문자여부 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS MBL_TELNO_ENCPT /* 휴대전화번호암호화 */ , CNTN_IP_ADDR AS CNTN_IP_ADDR /* 접속아이피주소 */
, CHTT_DSCSN_SRVC_UTZTN_YN AS CHTT_DSCSN_SRVC_UTZTN_YN /* 채팅상담이용여부 */ , KATA_DSCSN_SRVC_UTZTN_YN AS KATA_DSCSN_SRVC_UTZTN_YN /* 카카오톡상담이용여부 */ , NTABRD_DSCSN_SRVC_UTZTN_YN AS NTABRD_DSCSN_SRVC_UTZTN_YN /* 게시판상담이용여부 */ , CHRCTR_DSCSN_SRVC_UTZTN_YN AS CHRCTR_DSCSN_SRVC_UTZTN_YN /* 문자상담이용여부 */ , SLRBT_DSCSN_SRVC_UTZTN_YN AS SLRBT_DSCSN_SRVC_UTZTN_YN /* 솔로봇상담이용여부 */ , PARNTS_EDU_CNCT_SRVC_UTZTN_YN AS PARNTS_EDU_CNCT_SRVC_UTZTN_YN /* 부모교육이음상담이용여부 */ , NVL2(VOC_ETC_SRVC_NM, 'Y', 'N') AS ETC_SRVC_UTZTN_YN /* 기타서비스이용여부 */ , VOC_ETC_SRVC_NM AS VOC_ETC_SRVC_NM /* 기타이용서비스명 */ , BBSCTT_CN AS BBSCTT_CN /* 내용 */ , NVL(YC1388_FILE_URL_ADDR, '-') AS YC1388_FILE_URL_ADDR /* 첨부파일실제경로 */ , FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID /* 최초등록아이디??? */ , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AYE120 BB WHERE 1=1 AND BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD ) AS SUB_COUNT FROM AYE100 AA WHERE 1 = 1 AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '09'
mapper.update: UPDATE AYE100 SET/*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsVocListMapper : 고객의소리(삭제)*/ DEL_YN = 'Y' /*삭제여부*/ , LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE /*최종수정일자*/ , LAST_MDFR_ID = #{LAST_MDFR_ID} /*최종수정아이디*/ WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '09' /*게시글유형구분코드*/ AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO__origin} /*게시글고유번호*/
mapper.select: SELECT /*SQL-ID : selectRespodDetail 댓글상담실(댓글조회)*/ BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /*게시글번호*/ ,BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /*게시글구분코드*/ ,CMNT_ESNTAL_NO /*댓글고유번호*/ ,CMNT_CN /*댓글내용*/ ,WRTR_NM_ENCPT /*작성자*/ ,DEL_YN /*삭제여부*/ ,CNTN_IP_ADDR /*접속아이피주소*/ ,FRST_RGTR_ID /*최초등록아이디*/ ,to_char(FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FRST_REG_DT /*최초등록일자*/ ,LAST_MDFR_ID /*최종수정아이디*/ ,TO_CHAR(LAST_MDFCN_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS LAST_MDFCN_DT /*최종수정일자*/ FROM AYE110 WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '09' /*게시글유형구분코드*/ AND DEL_YN = 'N' /*삭제여부*/ AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} /*게시글번호*/

CMNT_CN, /*댓글내용*/
